lines: Main moved to `ad011f2b` at 01:25 UTC (6:25 PM MT): spring's base, fall's air, two clamps in the ring's shader by the strict check, and my two guards, with their checks read on the merged tree (01:04:57 to 01:24:34 UTC): tsc exit 0, spring's base made and committed, build exit 0 (engine `04d60c2dcdbccaa1`), "pass M3 spring-rest: 0.8298", "FAIL M3 fall-rest: 0.6996" (unchanged: the line reads base and miniature, which this chain did not touch), eight draft stills (winter's and summer's four byte equal, spring's and fall's four changed), triangles at high under the limit in every season (fall the fullest, 1,791,325 of 1,800,000), the whole vitest 839 passed and 4 skipped. Open items 244 (the blue blocks at the left of summer's glass) and 250 (an address that names a set of files the host does not hold) are mended and closed. Passing these checks is not the bar: spring, summer and fall are below it by eye.

The app is being published again from that head: its 40 first pictures are being drawn again since 01:25:49 UTC, then the publish build in a clean tree and a fresh security review. The address does not change.

Picture 1, rough draft 5 (Preview 05 is the video): twenty four frames across the whole film. It was drawn from main as of 00:43 UTC (`f4df90d1`): it has the hand's inertia and not yet summer's tree fifth pass, winter's mend at 3840, spring's new base or fall's air's last pass. 12 chunks from three helper machines, 1,800 frames at 960x540, joined behind the prompt opening to 2,233 frames, 74.43 s, with the film's sound. Scan of all chunks: no dark frame, no stalled pair of frames, no page message; 7 strongly blue pixels in three frames (film frames 2362, 2496, 2648). Below the bar, as the stills before said: the changes of season (a pale wash over the picture, the base changing under it), summer's tree and base, fall's air and base, spring's flank.

Picture 2, fall's base: approved above, main in the middle, the builder's push below. Decision 176: the push is held and not merged. It reads "FAIL M3 fall-rest: 0.6449" with the base at 0.645 against main's 0.700; the vines are darker and nearer and the left tangle has thin twigs, but the pumpkins went darker (approved middle pumpkin luminance median 29, main 20) and the leather at the right reads as grey speckle. Second list sent 01:21 UTC: near black wet vines with one long narrow highlight, creased leather, lit orange rinds; a line at 02:10 UTC, limit 03:00 UTC.

Picture 3, winter into spring at 3840, film frame 631 from a render machine, a cut at full size and its lights at four times: every light is a row of beads. The cause is found by the shutter's builder and that machine, and it is not the cap of 96 samples that I named earlier: the times of the samples inside a frame are uneven (a gap every seventh sample), each sample sits at its own place in the pixel so a small light lands 0 to 3 times in a pixel, and the two marks the rule counts travel by miss the ball's twist. The mend: more marks, even times, and each sample spread over one sample's travel along the ball's own motion, only at the final tier and only in moving frames; rest frames must stay byte equal. Due 03:30 UTC. Not seen yet: any frame after the mend.

A new open item, 251, found while joining the draft: chunk 3000 to 3298 was drawn by two machines from the same commit and the two files differ after decoding (144 of 150 frames, a median of 62,187 pixels a frame over 8 levels, nearly equal at the first frame and drifting apart). It may be the coding alone; if the drawn frames differ, chunks of the masters from twelve machines would step at their joins. Both machines were asked at 01:35 UTC for the hashes of their drawn frames. No master frame is drawn before this is settled.

The miniatures made in steps (branch `agent/p6-steps`, `1b0552f3`, pushed 01:23 UTC): the page no longer stands still while a season is made. Its builder reads M3 summer 0.8818, eight draft stills equal to main's, the four miniatures built whole and in steps to the same sha256, tsc 0, vitest 860 passed and 8 skipped, determinism pass. On a real graphics card the fit to a frame is UNKNOWN. It merges in the next chain, after the publish.

Second lists are out to spring's base (01:09 UTC), fall's air (01:18) and fall's base (01:21). 15 agents are at work at 01:36 UTC: summer (tree, miniature, air, glass, sand, stone), fall (base, miniature, air), spring (base), the change of season, the controls, the shutter, and two draft machines on the question of item 251.

Render counts. Drawn here since the last status: the app's first pictures, about half of 40 so far. On helper machines: the last 4 chunks of rough draft 5 (600 frames at 960x540) and one chunk drawn twice (150 frames), and at 3840 the shutter's builder drew film frame 678 and draws 643 and 300. No frame of the masters yet.
Sound: 7,420 of 10,000 credits, unchanged, no call planned.
